definitions.explanation: The rear wheel(s) of a vehicle — most often a car, motorcycle, or bicycle. Contrasts with {前輪|ぜんりん} (front wheel).

examples.japanese: {後輪|こうりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦パンク→パンク：10537_panku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦カー→カー：00130_kaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後輪|こうりん}{駆動|くどう}だ。
examples.english: Many sports cars are rear-wheel drive.

examples.japanese: {雪道|ゆきみち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後輪|こうりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}した→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧。
examples.english: Since the rear wheels slip easily on snowy roads, I drove cautiously.

notes:
Compound of {後|こう} (rear/behind) + {輪|りん} (wheel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後輪|こうりん}{駆動|くどう}: rear-wheel drive (RWD)
- {後輪|こうりん}⟦ブレーキ→ブレーキ：00022_bureeki⟧: rear brake
- {後輪|こうりん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}る→滑る：01230_suberu⟧: the rear wheels slip

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前輪|ぜんりん}→前輪：28610_zenrin⟧: front wheel — the direct opposite
- ⟦{両輪|りょうりん}→両輪：28859_ryourin⟧: both wheels (also figurative: two essential parts of something)
- {四輪|よんりん}⟦{駆動|くどう}→駆動：24244_kudou⟧: four-wheel drive (4WD)
